crossRefs.note: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
crossRefs.keyword: a stranger. Heb. a man, a stranger

crossRefs.note: Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
crossRefs.keyword: a stranger. Heb. a man, a stranger

translations.web: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
translations.bsb: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.
translations.kjv: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
translations.asv: And if a priest's daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.
